"""One-client robot episode runner. Commands are recorded in commands.jsonl."""
import sys, json, pathlib, traceback, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
import requests
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
print('READY', json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)
seq=0
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        cmd=json.loads(line)
        with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(cmd)+'\n')
        op=cmd.pop('op')
        if op=='status': print(json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True); continue
        if op=='ik': print(json.dumps(r.ik(**cmd)),flush=True); continue
        if op=='fk': print(json.dumps(r.fk(**cmd)),flush=True); continue
        if op=='obs': res=r.get_obs(**cmd)
        elif op=='move':
            typ=cmd.pop('type','ee_pose'); a=cmd.pop('actions'); res=r.submit(typ,a,**cmd)
        else: raise ValueError(op)
        seq+=1; dest=f'/app/runs/{seq:03d}';res.save(dest)
        for cam,a in res.last.items(): np.save(OUT/f'{cam}.npy',a)
        for cam,a in res.last_depth.items(): np.save(OUT/f'{cam}_depth.npy',a)
        (OUT/'latest_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2))
        print('RESULT',dest,json.dumps(res.meta),flush=True)
    except EpisodeOver as e:
        print('EPISODE_OVER',str(e),json.dumps(r.status()),flush=True)
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException:
        print('SERVICE_ERROR waiting for same episode',flush=True)
        print('RECOVERED',json.dumps(r.wait_ready()),flush=True)
    except Exception:
        traceback.print_exc()
